headline: ARC Slayer vaults from 215th into ARC-3 gold

sections.text: ARC Slayer surged from 215th to 7th, gaining 9.97 points to reach 41.19 and cross into the 18 gold places.
The jump puts the team inside gold with room between it and the cutoff: the final gold place is 18th, while Lord Han Solo sits just outside in 19th, only 0.09 short.

sources.title: ARC-AGI-3 public leaderboard: saved board and the past day's changes
